description: This Swift source file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for periodically and immediately sending system presence and status information, such as network details, app version, and input activity, to a control channel. It includes methods to start and stop reporting, compose status summaries, and retrieve environment data.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for periodically and immediately reporting system presence data to a control channel, including system info, app version, and user input activity.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic presence reporting task if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the presence reporting task if it is running.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Gathers system and app data, then sends it as a system event through the control channel.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Immediately triggers a presence update, typically after connecting.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a textual summary of the current presence status, including host, IP, app version, last input, mode, and reason.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the application version string, including the build number if available.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the operating system platform version.
